name: 21493-image1080p-vl3b-8gpu
hardware: 4x H100 80GB HBM3 on one a3 node.
parallelism: TP=4, PP=1, DP=1, one in-process vLLM engine. Four-way is the widest tensor-parallel split this checkpoint's weight shapes admit and is part of the declaration; TP=2 or TP=1 is a different, weaker operating point.
architecture: Qwen2_5_VLForConditionalGeneration, bf16, 3.75B params: a 36-layer language model (hidden 2048, 16 query / 2 KV heads, head_dim 128) behind a 32-layer vision tower (hidden 1280, 16 heads, patch 14, spatial_merge 2).
load_profile: concurrent (closed loop), streams=64, bounded at 640 requests with a 900 s safety cap, first 20% warmup and a declared 10% cooldown. At least 512 requests are scored; the exact count is only knowable from the run, so do not quote one in advance.
workload: guidellm synthetic, one distinct 1920x1080 JPEG (gradient, q85, seed 42) per request plus a fixed 16-token instruction, 256 output tokens fixed. smart_resize rounds each image to 1932x1092, i.e. 2691 tokens after the 2x2 spatial merge, so the engine sees ~2700-2750 prompt tokens rather than the 16 declared.
purpose: A vision assistant captioning full-HD photos for 64 concurrent users on a four-GPU node, 256-token replies.
launch:
model: Qwen/Qwen2.5-VL-3B-Instruct
tensor-parallel-size: 4
max-model-len: 32768
trust-remote-code: true
max-num-seqs: 64
# Not a default that can be dropped: `vllm serve` picks 8192 on a card of this class, while an
# engine constructed in-process falls back to 2048, which is a different prefill shape.
max-num-batched-tokens: 8192
dtype: bfloat16
enable-prefix-caching: true
limit-mm-per-prompt: {"image": 1}
gpu-memory-utilization: 0.9
